entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A shard of Alara where all creatures are infused with etherium and mages and sphinxes rule, subjugating nature under thaumaturgical control.

entities.name: Etherium
entities.description: A magical alloy that infuses all creatures on Esper and is used to refine and perfect flesh.

entities.name: The Ethersworn
entities.description: A group of Esper mages devoted to infusing all life on the plane with etherium, calling it the Noble Work.

entities.name: Sharuum the Hegemon
entities.description: The sphinx who rules Esper and envisions using etherium to make the whole plane ascend to a new level of consciousness.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard of Alara full of knights, paladins, battle angels and castles, divided into five nations under a caste system.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane that once was a single plane before splitting into shards.

entities.name: Jhess
entities.description: A coastal nation of Bant, currently at war with Valeron.

entities.name: Valeron
entities.description: A coastal nation of Bant, currently at war with Jhess.

entities.name: Akrasa
entities.description: A central savannah nation of Bant.

entities.name: Eos
entities.description: A central savannah nation of Bant.

entities.name: Topa
entities.description: A central savannah nation of Bant.

events.summary: After Alara split into shards, Bant's martial traditions became ceremonial and ritualized.
events.quote: Over the years, Bant's armies became less martial and more ceremonial.

events.summary: Jhess and Valeron, two nations of Bant, are at war.
events.quote: Jhess and Valeron, for instance, are currently at war
